description.value: Osmanthus is a fine-dining Chinese restaurant on Level 2 of Aberdeen Centre in Richmond, specializing in Jiangnan cuisine with roots in the Song Dynasty. The restaurant has hosted a Michelin Chef's Night event and offers an extensive menu of crafted beverages alongside its food menu. Touring cyclists looking for an upscale sit-down meal in Richmond's busy Aberdeen Centre area will find this a distinctive cultural dining experience.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 42m; rack (8 spaces) at 53m. Total: 8 spaces.
